rulings.deciding_printed_evidence: Comment p.637 (printed 620) prints the whole projection proof under the Comment's own hypothesis: m maximizing |P_m(A)|; F the fibres of full length n; each a outside F giving a distinct interior boundary edge, hence |d_E A| >= |P_m(A) minus F|; the Loomis-Whitney product |A|^{(d-1)/d} <= prod_j |P_j(A)| <= |P_m(A)|^d; the arithmetic step |P_m(A)| >= |A|/|A|^{1/d} >= 2^{1/d}|A|/n >= 2^{1/d}|F|; and the final |d_E A| >= (1 - 2^{-1/d})|A|^{(d-1)/d}.
rulings.why_the_owner_label_does_not_survive: The owner row states in source_state 'prints the whole projection proof' and in support 'A complete printed proof, including the explicit constant', and prose_outcome lists 6.74 among the full-proof rows; the row carries no owner_reason_for_downgrade, unlike 6.69, 6.79 and 6.82. The H1 label was therefore carried from the model's 'low' rather than argued from the printed text. Applying the standard, the printed core covers the full stated target.
residues_kept_literal: The exercise states |A| < n^{d/2}; the Comment proves under |A| < n^d/2. For n >= 2 the Comment's hypothesis is the weaker one (n^d/2 = n^{d/2} * n^{d/2} / 2 >= n^{d/2}), so the exercise hypothesis is a subcase and the transfer is an inclusion, not a repair. Both literals retained; neither rewritten.
Small n must be absorbed into C_d. Mechanical.
C_d may be taken as 1 - 2^{-1/d}. Mechanical.

rulings.deciding_printed_evidence: Comment p.637 (printed 620) prints the full lower-bound argument: the confinement estimate P_v[max_{j<=r^2}|X_j| <= 2r and |X_{r^2}| <= r] >= e^{-c}; the Markov iteration at multiples of r^2 giving e^{-c ceil(n/r^2)}; the simultaneous last-visit lamp-off on [-2r,2r] together with return to the origin giving p_n(o,o) >= exp(-c n/r^2 - c_1 r); and the optimisation r = n^{1/3}.
rulings.why_the_owner_label_does_not_survive: The owner row states in source_state 'prints the block argument in full' and in support 'A complete printed lower-bound argument', and prose_outcome lists 6.78 among the rows the exercise 'only asks to restate'; the row carries no owner_reason_for_downgrade.
residues_kept_literal: The exercise asks p_{2n}(o,o); the Comment's final display writes p_n(o,o). Since the printed estimate is uniform in n, substituting 2n is a relabelling; both literals retained, neither rewritten.

The block confinement estimate is asserted 'for some constant c' rather than derived inside the Comment. This is the book's own standing style for such estimates and no part of the asked target is left uncovered by it.
ceil(n/r^2) absorbed into n/r^2 + 1 and C assembled from c, c_1. Mechanical.

rulings.deciding_printed_evidence: Comment p.638 (printed 621) prints the whole proof: the non-exponential tail gives P[sum L_i >= cn] >= P[L_1 >= cn] >= e^{-eps n} for infinitely many n; the 2^n pairwise disjoint level-n to level-2n paths give, by union bound, 1 - exp(-e^{-eps n} 2^n) -> 1; extending a good path to the root gives |d_E S| / sum_{e in E(S)} L_e <= (2n+1)/(cn) ~ 2/c; c arbitrary gives Phi**_E(G_nu) = 0 a.s.
rulings.why_the_owner_label_does_not_survive: The owner row states in support 'A complete printed proof of the main assertion', and prose_outcome lists 6.88 among the full-proof rows; the row carries no owner_reason_for_downgrade.
rulings.owner_link_error_corrected_in_the_privat: The owner row's source_compression names 'the body inequality Phi**_E <= Phi*_E' as the printed link. That implication runs the wrong way: Phi**_E = 0 together with Phi**_E <= Phi*_E implies nothing about Phi*_E. The printed link that does close the step is an equality, stated on body physical p.238: for trees |E(K)| = |K| - 1, so Phi**_E(G) = Phi*_E(G) for trees. G is a binary tree and the random subdivision G_nu is again a tree, so the two anchored constants agree and the Comment's conclusion transfers literally. Locally the same fact is |S| = |E(S)| + 1 on the single extended path. The author's mathematics is not altered and the exercise text is not rewritten; only the owner's claimed link is corrected.
residues_kept_literal: The exercise asks Phi*_E(G_nu) = 0; the Comment's last display concludes Phi**_E(G_nu) = 0. Both retained.
The Comment's first equivalence, reading 'slower than exponential decay' as failure of an exponential tail, is asserted rather than derived. Recorded; not derived here.

rulings.deciding_printed_evidence: Comment p.636 (printed 619) prints the nonamenable reduction in full: (18.5) cross-referenced to the first paragraph of the Theorem 6.19 proof and (6.37); kappa_n and lambda_n defined; the two one-step inequalities printed; a printed explicitly as the square of (d-Phi)(d'-Phi')/((d+Phi)(d'+Phi')) with a < 1; the convolution 2 kappa_n <= 2 kappa_0 a^{n-1} + sum_j a^j b_{n-j}; b_n -> 0; kappa_n -> 0 and hence lambda_n -> 0.
rulings.why_this_is_not_a_counting_difference: Both passes leave 6.69 out of the countable set. The owner files it H1 under a standing precedent for a fully printed nearby author proof with only an adaptation left; the independent reviewer files it H2_material_incomplete_full_target because the printed core is substantial while the amenable case is asserted 'trivial' and (18.5) is only cross-referenced. Both descriptions are of the same text and neither claims a complete core.
rulings.why_no_supersession: The owner row carries a written owner_reason_for_downgrade naming the precedent, so the label rests on an argument rather than on the model's tag. That argument is legitimate and the count is unaffected either way; overriding it would change a label without changing any tally.
rulings.retained_owner_reading: Not countable: the amenable case is asserted, not argued, so not every part of the stated target is covered by the Comment.
